hero.title: Our Leadership Team
hero.subtitle: Dedicated visionaries guiding Ablaal Schools toward educational excellence
hero.subtitleSo: Kuwa aragti leh oo dhexdhexaad ah oo hogaamiya Dugsiyada Ablaal si loo helo waxsanaan waxbarasho

founder.name: Prof. Abdirahman Moalim Ahmed Ablaal
founder.title: Founder & Chairman
founder.bio: Professor Abdirahman Moalim Ahmed Ablaal founded Ablaal Schools in 1988 with a vision to provide quality education to the children of Somalia. With over 35 years of experience in education, he has been the driving force behind the school's growth and excellence.
founder.bioSo: Profesoor Cabdiraxmaan Moalim Axmed Ablaal wuxuu aasaasay Dugsiyada Ablaal sanadkii 1988 si uu u bixiyo waxbarasho tayo leh carruurta Soomaaliya. Waxa uu leeyahay in ka badan 35 sano oo khibrad ah oo waxbarasho ah, wuxuuna ahaa xoogga koboca iyo waxsanaanta dugsiga.
founder.message: Education is the foundation upon which we build our future. At Ablaal Schools, we are committed to nurturing the next generation of leaders, thinkers, and change-makers who will shape Somalia's tomorrow.
founder.messageSo: Waxbarashadu waa aasaaska aynu ku dhismayno mustaqbalkayaga. Dugsiyada Ablaal, waxaan u dhaqannaa jiilka xigee ee hoggaamiyeyaasha, fikirayaasha, iyo beddelayaasha ee qeexaya berri Soomaaliya.

directors.name: Dr. Sakariye Ablaal
directors.title: Director General
directors.bio: Dr. Sakariye oversees all academic operations and strategic planning for Ablaal Schools. He holds a PhD in Educational Leadership and has 20+ years of experience in school administration.
directors.bioSo: Dr. Sakariye wuxuu maamulaa dhammaan howlaha waxbarasho iyo qorsheynta istiraatiijiyadeed ee Dugsiyada Ablaal. Waxa uu leeyahay PhD oo Hogaanka Waxbarasho ah oo uu leeyahay 20+ sano oo khibrad ah oo maamul dugsiyeed ah.

directors.name: Ms. Fadumo Ibrahim
directors.title: Academic Director
directors.bio: Ms. Fadumo leads our curriculum development and teacher training programs. She is passionate about innovative teaching methods and student-centered learning.
directors.bioSo: Marwo Fadumo wuxuu hogaamiyaa horumarinta manhajkeena iyo barnaamijyada tababarka barayaasha. Waxay ku dhacsan tahay hababka waxbarasho ee hal-abuureed iyo waxbarasho oo ardayda ku dhex saabsan.

directors.name: Mr. Omar Hassan
directors.title: Operations Director
directors.bio: Mr. Omar manages the day-to-day operations across all Ablaal School branches, ensuring smooth functioning and quality service delivery.
directors.bioSo: Mr. Cumar wuxuu maamulaa howlaha maalinlaha ah ee dhammaan laamaha Dugsiga Ablaal, hubina inay si siman u shaqeeyaan oo adeeg tayo leh bixiyaan.

directors.name: Ms. Amina Ali
directors.title: Student Affairs Director
directors.bio: Ms. Amina oversees student welfare, counseling services, and extracurricular activities, ensuring every student thrives both academically and personally.
directors.bioSo: Marwo Aamina wuxuu maamulaa daboolka ardayda, adeegyada talada, iyo hawlaha dheeraadka ah, hubina in arday kastu uu koro waxbarasho iyo shaqsiyanba.

directors.name: Mr. Mohamed Farah
directors.title: Finance Director
directors.bio: Mr. Mohamed manages the financial operations and ensures sustainable growth while maintaining affordability for families.
directors.bioSo: Mr. Maxamed wuxuu maamulaa howlaha maaliyadeed oo hubiyaa koboc waara inta lagu jiro ilaalinta qiimaha qoysaska.

leadership.message: Together, our leadership team is committed to upholding the highest standards of education and creating an environment where every student can achieve their dreams.
leadership.messageSo: Wadajir, kooxdeena hogaanka waxaan u dhaqannaa xeerarka ugu sarreeya ee waxbarasho oo abuuraya deegaan ay arday kastu u gaari karto riyadooda.

hero.title: Mission & Vision
hero.subtitle: The guiding principles that shape everything we do at Ablaal Schools
hero.subtitleSo: Mabaadi'da hoggaamiya wax kasta oo aan ku sameyno Dugsiyada Ablaal

whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.content: Ablaal Primary and Secondary Schools have played a pioneering role in Somalia's education sector since 1988. As a non-profit private institution, we remain committed to accessible, high-quality education for all. We were Somalia's first English-medium K-12 school, setting a precedent for modern academic programs in the country.
whoWeAre.contentSo: Dugsiyada Hoose iyo Dhexe ee Ablaal waxay ciyaarey door hogaamineed oo ku saabsan waxbarashada Soomaaliya tan iyo 1988. Hay'ad gaar ah oo aan faa'iido doon ahayn, waxaan ku dhaqannaa waxbarasho tayo leh oo la heli karo oo dhammaan. Waxaan ahaanay dugsiga ugu horreeyay ee Ingiriisi-ah ee K-12 ee Soomaaliya, oo dejiyey qaacidooyin waxbarasho casri ah oo dalka.

core.title: The Core of Ablaal Schools
core.content: At the heart of Ablaal Schools lies a deep commitment to educational excellence, character development, and community service. We believe that education is not just about academic achievement but about shaping responsible, compassionate citizens who will contribute positively to society.
core.contentSo: Xuduudka Dugsiyada Ablaal waxaa ku yaal dhammaan dhaqan ahaan u dhaqan waxsanaan waxbarasho, kobcinta dabeecadda, iyo adeegga bulshada. Waxaan qabannaa in waxbarashadu aanay ahayn waxbarasho oo keliya ee ay tahay in lagu qeexo muwaadiniin mas'uul ah oo naxariis leh oo bulshada si wanaagsan ugu dhex shaqeeya.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: To provide a high-quality, inclusive education that nurtures the intellectual, emotional, and social development of every student. We are committed to fostering a dynamic learning environment where students are encouraged to explore their potential, think critically, and act wisely with integrity.
mission.contentSo: Inaan bixiyo waxbarasho tayo leh oo dhex-mid ah oo daryeela horumarka maskaxda, dareenka, iyo bulshada ee arday kasta. Waxaan u dhaqannaa deegaan waxbarasho oo firfircoon halkaas oo ardayda lagu dhiirrigeliyo inay sahamiyaan kartidooda, si qoto dheer u fikiraan, oo si caqli leh u dhaqmaan oo daacad ah.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.content: To be a leading educational institution, fostering academic excellence, critical thinking, and personal growth. We aim to empower students with the knowledge, skills, and values necessary to succeed in a rapidly changing world.
vision.contentSo: Inaan noqono hay'ad waxbarasho oo hogaamineysa, oo kobcisa waxsanaan waxbarasho, fikir qoto dheer, iyo koboc shaqsiyeed. Waxaan u jeednaa inaan ardayda u xoojino aqoon, xirfadaha, iyo qiimayaasha loo baahan yahay si ay ugu guuleystaan adduun si dhakhso ah isbeddelaya.

purpose.title: Our Purpose
purpose.content: We exist to transform lives through education. Every decision we make, every program we implement, and every interaction we have with our students is guided by our desire to make a lasting positive impact on their lives and the communities they serve. Our motto: Working together for students' success.
purpose.contentSo: Waxaan u jirnaa inaan beddelno nolosha waxbarasho. Go'aan kasta oo aan qaadno, barnaamij kasta oo aan hirgelino, iyo isweydaarsiga kasta oo aan la yeelanno ardaydeena waxaa hogaamiya rabitaankeena inaan saamayn togan oo waara ku yeelanno noloshooda iyo bulshadooda ay u adeegaan. Maahmaahdayada: Wadajir u shaqeyna guusha ardayda.

hero.title: Our Core Values
hero.subtitle: The principles that guide our actions and shape our culture
hero.subtitleSo: Mabaadi'da hoggaamiya ficilladeena oo qeexaya dhaqankeena

values.title: Excellence
values.description: We strive for excellence in everything we do, setting high standards and continuously improving to achieve the best outcomes for our students.
values.descriptionSo: Waxaan u dadaalnaa waxsanaan wax kasta oo aan sameyno, dejineynaa heerar sare oo sii wadnaa horumar si aan u gaarno natiijooyinka ugu fiican ardaydeena.

values.title: Integrity
values.description: We act with honesty, transparency, and ethical behavior in all our interactions, building trust with our community.
values.descriptionSo: Waxaan ku dhaqannaa daacadnimo, daahfurnaan, iyo dhaqan anshax leh oo dhammaan isweydaarsigayaga, dhismaya kalsooni bulshadeena.

values.title: Innovation
values.description: We embrace creativity and innovation, constantly seeking new and better ways to educate and inspire our students.
values.descriptionSo: Waxaan dhiirrigelinaa hal-abuur iyo hal-abuur, joogto ah raadisaya habab cusub oo ka wanaagsan oo waxbarasho oo ardaydeena dhiirrigeliya.

values.title: Community Engagement
values.description: We actively engage with our community, building strong partnerships with families and local organizations to support student success.
values.descriptionSo: Waxaan si firfircoon ula dhaqannaa bulshadeena, oo dhisanayna iskaashi xooggan oo qoysaska iyo ururada deegaanka si aan u taageerno guusha ardayda.

values.title: Respect
values.description: We value diversity and treat everyone with dignity and respect, creating an inclusive environment where all feel welcome.
values.descriptionSo: Waxaan qiimeynaa kala duwanaanshaha oo dhammaan waxaan ula dhaqannaa sharaf iyo ixtiraam, abuuraya deegaan dhex-mid ah oo dhammaan isku soo dhaweyn.

hero.title: Services & Facilities
hero.subtitle: World-class facilities and services designed to support every aspect of student life
hero.subtitleSo: Xarumaha heerka aduunka iyo adeegyada loogu talagalay inay taageeraan dhinac kasta oo nolosha ardayda

services.intro: At Ablaal Schools, we believe that a great education extends beyond the classroom. Our facilities and services are designed to create a holistic learning environment where students can thrive academically, socially, and personally.
services.introSo: Dugsiyada Ablaal, waxaan qabannaa in waxbarasho wanaagsan ay ka baxdo qolka fasalka. Xarumahayaga iyo adeegyadayagu waxay u talagalaan inay abuuraan deegaan waxbarasho oo dhammaystiran halkaas oo ardaydu ugu guuleysan karaan waxbarasho, bulsho, iyo shaqsiyanba.

items.title: Learning Environments
items.description: Our classrooms are designed to inspire learning, equipped with modern teaching aids, comfortable seating, and optimal lighting. We maintain small class sizes to ensure personalized attention for every student.
items.descriptionSo: Qolashadayada waxbarashadu waxay u talagalaan inay dhiirrigeliyaan waxbarasho, waxayna ku hubeeystay caawimaad waxbarasho casri ah, fadhi raaxo leh, iyo iftiin ugu fiican. Waxaan ilaalinaynaa cayimaha fasalka ee yaryar si aan u hubiyo daryeel gaar ah oo arday kasta.

items.title: Innovation & STEM Spaces
items.description: Our science laboratories, computer labs, and innovation spaces provide hands-on learning experiences. Students have access to the latest technology and equipment to explore, experiment, and create.
items.descriptionSo: Laboratoryo sayniseed, kompyutar lab, iyo meelaha hal-abuurkeenu waxay bixiyaan waayo-aragnimo waxbarasho oo gacanta ku jirta. Ardaydu waxay helayaan teknoolojiyadda ugu dambeysa iyo qalabka si ay u sahamiyaan, tijaabiyaan, iyo abuuraan.

items.title: Library & Resource Center
items.description: Our well-stocked library offers a vast collection of books, digital resources, and quiet study spaces. Students can explore literature, conduct research, and develop a love for reading.
items.descriptionSo: Maktabadeena oo si fiican u buuxda waxay bixisaa urur weyn oo buugaag, ilo dijitaal ah, iyo meelaha barashada deggan. Ardaydu waxay sahamin karaan suugaan, cilmibaaris sameyn karaan, kobciyaan jacaylka akhriska.

items.title: Sports & Recreation
items.description: Our sports facilities include playgrounds, basketball courts, and indoor game areas. We encourage physical activity and team sports to promote health, fitness, and teamwork.
items.descriptionSo: Xarumaha ciyaarkeena waxaa ka mid ah meelaha ciyaaraha, garoomayaasha kubadda koleyga, iyo meelaha ciyaaraha gudaha. Waxaan dhiirrigelinaynaa dhaqanka jirka iyo ciyaaraha kooxda si loo dhiirrigeliyo caafimaadka, jimicsiga, iyo shaqada kooxda.

services.title: On Campus — Ablaal School Services
services.intro: A great education is more than what happens in the classroom. From wellbeing to daily convenience, our on-campus services ensure every student and family feels supported throughout their school journey.
services.introSo: Waxbarasho wanaagsan waa ka badan waxa ka dhaca qolka fasalka. Laga bilaabo caafimaadka ilaa habeenkii maalintii, adeegyadayada xarunta waxay hubiyaan in arday kasta iyo qoys uu dareemo taageero oo dhan safarkooda dugsiyeed.

items.title: Counselling
items.description: Our professional counselors provide academic guidance, career counseling, and emotional support. Students can access one-on-one sessions to discuss personal challenges and develop coping strategies.
items.descriptionSo: Talo-biyayaasha xirfadeed ee waxay bixiyaan hagid waxbarasho, talo-xidhmo xirfad, iyo taageero dareen. Ardaydu waxay helayaan kulammo hal-kiiba si ay uga hadlaan caqabadaha shaqsiga ah oo ay kobciyaan istiraatiijiyadaha la dagaallamaya.

items.title: Campus Security
items.description: The safety of our students is our top priority. Our campuses are equipped with security personnel, CCTV monitoring, and controlled access points to ensure a safe learning environment.
items.descriptionSo: Nabadgelyada ardaydeenu waa mudnaanta koowaad. Xarumahayagu waxay ku hubeeystay shaqaalaha amniga, kormeerka CCTV, iyo daaqadaha gelitaanka la xakameeyo si loo hubiyo deegaan waxbarasho oo ammaan ah.

items.title: Bus Services
items.description: We provide safe and reliable transportation services covering major areas of Mogadishu. Our buses are well-maintained, driven by trained drivers, and monitored for student safety.
items.descriptionSo: Waxaan bixinaa adeegyo gaadhsiin oo ammaan ah oo la kalsoonaan karo oo daboolaya meelaha waaweyn ee Muqdisho. Basaskayadu waxay si fiican u ilaaliyaan, waxaa wata darawallo tababar la siiyay, waxaana la kormeeraa nabadgelyada ardayda.

items.title: Health & Wellness
items.description: Our school clinics provide basic healthcare services, first aid, and health education. We conduct regular health check-ups and maintain health records for all students.
items.descriptionSo: Isbitaallada dugsiyeed ee waxay bixiyaan adeegyada caafimaadka aasaasiga ah, gargaarka koowaad, iyo waxbarashada caafimaadka. Waxaan sameynaynaa baaritaannada caafimaadka joogtada ah oo aan hayno diiwaanada caafimaadka ee ardayda oo dhan.

hero.title: Primary School
hero.subtitle: Building strong foundations for lifelong learning
hero.subtitleSo: Dhismaya aasaas xooggan oo waxbarasho nolosha oo dhan

primary.description: Our Primary Education program focuses on foundational learning in Literacy (English, Somali, Arabic), Numeracy (Mathematics), Basic Sciences, Social Studies, Islamic Studies, and Creative Arts. We create a nurturing environment where young learners can explore, discover, and grow.
primary.descriptionSo: Barnaamijkeena Waxbarashada Hoose waxuu diiradda saarayaa waxbarashada aasaasiga ah ee Akhriska (Ingiriisi, Soomaali, Carabi), Xisaabta (Xisaabta), Sayniska Aasaasiga ah, Cilmiga Bulshada, Cilmiga Islaamka, iyo Farshaxanka Hal-abuurka. Waxaan abuuraynaa deegaan daryeel ah halkaas oo ardayda yaryaru ay sahamin, hel, koro karaan.

programs.description: Our lower primary program introduces students to core academic subjects while developing social skills and creativity through interactive learning.
programs.descriptionSo: Barnaamijkeenna hoose ee dugsiga hoose wuxuu ardayda ku soo bandhigaa mawduucyada waxbarasho ee aasaasiga ah inta lagu jiro kobcinta xirfadaha bulshada iyo hal-abuurka waxbarasho isweydaarsiga ah.

programs.caption: Primary students at assembly
programs.captionSo: Ardayda dugsiga hoose ee isu imaatinka

hero.title: Secondary School
hero.subtitle: Preparing students for higher education and future careers
hero.subtitleSo: Ardayda ku diyaarinaya waxbarashada sare iyo xirfadaha mustaqbalka

secondary.description: Our Secondary Education program provides advanced studies in Science, Technology, Mathematics, Languages, and Social Sciences (History & Geography), and Business. We emphasize critical thinking, independent learning, and character development to prepare students for national examinations and future success.
secondary.descriptionSo: Barnaamijkeenna Waxbarashada Dhexe wuxuu bixiyaa waxbarasho horumarineed oo ku saabsan Sayniska, Tiknoolajiyada, Xisaabta, Luuqadaha, iyo Cilmiga Bulshada (Taariikh & Juqraafi), iyo Ganacsiga. Waxaan diiradda saarnaa fikirka qoto dheer, waxbarashada madax-bannaan, iyo kobcinta dabeecadda si aan u diyaarinno ardayda imtixaannada qaran iyo guusha mustaqbalka.

programs.description: Our secondary program offers a rigorous curriculum designed to prepare students for national examinations and university entrance. We provide career guidance and support students in making informed decisions about their future.
programs.descriptionSo: Barnaamijkeenna dugsiga dhexe wuxuu bixiyaa manhaj adag oo loogu talagalay inuu ardayda u diyaariyo imtixaannada qaran iyo gelitaanka jaamacadda. Waxaan bixinaa hagid xirfad oo ardayda taageera go'aan qaadashada macluumaadka ku saabsan mustaqbalkooda.

hero.title: Admissions
hero.subtitle: Join the Ablaal Schools family and give your child the gift of quality education
hero.subtitleSo: Ku biir qoysaka Dugsiyada Ablaal oo siiso ilmahaaga hadiyadda waxbarasho tayo leh

requirements.title: Admission Requirements
itemsSo: Sawirro laba ah oo baasaboor cabbir ah oo dhowaan
Imtixaanka gelitaanka (qaar ka mid ah fasalada)

steps.title: Submit Application
steps.description: Complete and submit the online or in-person application form along with required documents.
steps.descriptionSo: Dhammaystir oo gudbi foomka codsiga khadka tooska ah ama qof ahaan oo ku jira warqadaha loo baahan yahay.

steps.title: Entrance Assessment
steps.description: Students may be required to take an entrance examination to assess their academic level.
steps.descriptionSo: Ardaydu waxay loo baahan yihiin inay qaadaan imtixaanka gelitaanka si loo qiimeyo heerka waxbarashadooda.

steps.title: Interview
steps.description: Parents/guardians and students will be invited for an interview with school administration.
steps.descriptionSo: Waalidka/ilaaliyeyaasha iyo ardayda waxaa loogu yeeri doonaa waraysi maamulka dugsiga.

steps.title: Admission Decision
steps.description: The school will notify families of the admission decision within two weeks of the interview.
steps.descriptionSo: Dugsigu waxuu ogeysiinayaa qoysaska go'aanka gelitaanka laba toddobaad gudahood kadib waraysiga.

steps.title: Enrollment
steps.description: Upon acceptance, complete the enrollment process by paying fees and submitting remaining documents.
steps.descriptionSo: Marka la aqbalo, dhammaystir habka is-diiwaangelinta adigoo bixinaya kharashka iyo gudbinta warqadaha hadhay.

scholarships.title: Scholarships & Financial Aid
scholarships.description: Ablaal Schools is committed to providing educational opportunities to all students, regardless of their financial situation. We offer over 1,000 full scholarships to deserving students each year.
scholarships.descriptionSo: Dugsiyada Ablaal waxay ku dhaqannaa inay bixiyaan fursad waxbarasho oo dhan ardayda oo dhan, iyadoo aan la eegin xaaladda dhaqaalaha. Waxaan bixinaa in ka badan 1,000 deeq waxbarasho oo buuxda oo ardayda mudan sanad kasta.

fees.title: School Fees
fees.note: For detailed fee information, please contact our admissions office at info@ablaalschools.so or call +252 612 277 993. We offer flexible payment plans and scholarships for deserving students. Our low-cost, high-quality education model ensures accessibility for all families.
fees.noteSo: Xogta faahfaahsan ee kharashka, fadlan nala soo xiriir xafiiska gelitaanka ee info@ablaalschools.so ama wac +252 612 277 993. Waxaan bixinaa qorshayaal lacag bixin oo deggan iyo deeqo waxbarasho ah oo ardayda mudan. Qaabkeenna waxbarasho oo qiimo jaban oo tayo sare leh wuxuu hubiyaa in la heli karo dhammaan qoysaska.

jobs.title: Mathematics Teacher
jobs.description: We are seeking an experienced Mathematics teacher for our secondary school program. The ideal candidate should have a degree in Mathematics or related field and at least 3 years of teaching experience.
jobs.descriptionSo: Waxaan raadinaynaa macallin xisaab oo khibrad leh oo barnaamijkeenna dugsiga dhexe. Musharaxa ugu fiican wuxuu u baahan yahay heer xisaab ama aasaas la mid ah oo ugu yaraan 3 sano oo khibrad waxbarasho ah.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Mathematics or related field
Passion for education and student development
requirementsSo: Shahaadada heerka koowaad ee Xisaabta ama aasaas la mid ah
Ugu yaraan 3 sano oo khibrad waxbarasho ah

jobs.title: School Principal
jobs.description: We are looking for an experienced school principal to lead our Yaaqshid campus. The successful candidate will be responsible for overall school management, academic excellence, and staff development.
jobs.descriptionSo: Waxaan raadinaynaa madax dugsiga oo khibrad leh oo hogaamiya xarunteena Yaaqshid. Musharaxa guuleysta wuxuu mas'uul ka noqon doonaa maareynta guud ee dugsiga, waxsanaanta waxbarasho, iyo kobcinta shaqaalaha.
requirements: Master's degree in Education or related field
Minimum 5 years experience in school leadership
requirementsSo: Shahaadada heerka labaad ee Waxbarashada ama aasaas la mid ah
Ugu yaraan 5 sano oo khibrad ah oo hogaanka dugsiga

stories.name: Dr. Fatima Omar
stories.story: My years at Ablaal Schools laid the foundation for my career in medicine. The rigorous academic program and supportive teachers prepared me for university and beyond.
stories.storySo: Sannadahaygii Dugsiyada Ablaal waxay dhiseen aasaaska xirfadkayga caafimaadka. Barnaamijka waxbarasho ee adag iyo barayaal taageerad ah ayaa ii diyaariyay jaamacadda iyo ka badan.

stories.name: Ahmed Hassan
stories.story: The computer science program at Ablaal sparked my passion for technology. Today, I work for a leading tech company and credit my success to the strong foundation I received.
stories.storySo: Barnaamijka sayniska kombiyuutarka ee Ablaal wuxuu shidday jacaylkayga teknoolojiyadda. Maanta, waxaan ka shaqeeyaa shirkad tech horey ugu socota oo waxaan ku ammaanaa guushayda aasaaska xooggan ee aan helo.
